title: Arknights PC Version FAQ
lines: 1. Where can I download the PC version?
The PC version of Arknights can be downloaded from the official website: https://www.arknights.global/
Please click the [Download Win Client] button on the homepage to start the download. We recommend choosing an installation location with sufficient available storage space.
2. What are the System Requirements for the PC version?
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent

4. Is account data shared between the mobile and PC versions?
Yes. Account data is fully synchronized across platforms, except for guest accounts.
Your game progress, owned Operators, resources, and all other account data will be shared, allowing you to freely play on PC / Android / iOS.
5. What are the features of the PC version?
Doctors can enjoy a more immersive battle experience on a larger screen, while using a keyboard and mouse for more precise Operator deployment and control.
All game content and account data are synchronized with the mobile version and shared across platforms.
6. What payment methods are supported on the PC version?

7. Will purchases made on mobile be synchronized to the PC version?
Yes. Purchase records and purchased content are fully synchronized across platforms for the same account.
No matter which platform you use to purchase resources or packs, the content will be applied to the same account.
8. What should I do if the game fails to launch properly?
Please try repairing the game via [Arknights PC Launcher] → [Settings] → [ Game Repair] .
If the issue persists after repairing, please contact Customer Support through the [Customer Support Center] in the PC launcher.
9. What should I do if I encounter other issues?
Please contact Customer Support through one of the following channels:
[Customer Support Center] in the PC launcher
If possible, please also provide the error code and details about when the issue occurred. This will help us assist you more efficiently.
